// diagnostic

E0155

A typed URL, Path, or DateTime literal is invalid or contains unsupported interpolation

What

A typed URL, Path, or DateTime literal is invalid or contains unsupported interpolation

Why

Typed literal types are checked before the program runs; URL and Path holes must stay inside components, and DateTime literals must be complete.

Fix

Write a valid typed literal with holes only in URL or Path components, or parse a runtime String explicitly

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0155: tests/ui/typed_literal_datetime_hole.stderr.

Error [E0155]: a `DateTime` literal cannot contain interpolation
  --> tests/ui/typed_literal_datetime_hole.jet:3:23
    |
  3 |     stamp :: DateTime{"2026-08-07T{hour}:00:00Z"}
    |                       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: DateTime values are checked as complete RFC3339 literals before the program runs
 Fix: write a complete `DateTime{"…"}` literal, or parse a runtime String explicitly
